title: Radio: CCSO deputy — report number and contacts

lines.text: The homeowner wants a report number for her insurance. I need your company contact, your insurance carrier and whether the FAA has been notified.
She also says nobody told her what was going on for the first half hour.

fields.voiceStyle: Woman in her 40s, professional, car radio

instructorNote: Watch for the details given and the homeowner’s complaint taken to the General Manager.

snapshot.title: UAS-02 Recovered — CCSO Report

lines.text: ASO, this is Deputy Callahan, CCSO. UAS-02 has been recovered from the grassy field near the old barn in the Birch Hollow Range. The aircraft is intact, battery was wet, and is now in a fire-safe container per HUOG-ERP Section 4.3. No injuries, no public interference. We used the site’s boat and life jackets. The recovery team is standing by for your direction on evidence handling.

fields.voiceStyle: Middle-aged male, calm but urgent, slight rural accent

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the physical recovery of UAS-02 and triggers the evidence chain-of-custody process. The ASO must now activate HUOG-ERP Section 4.3 and notify FSDO/NTSB. Watch for compliance with documentation and forensic handling.
